community_list_entries.name: SubtleMemory: A Benchmark for Fine-Grained Relational Memory Discrimination in Long-Horizon AI Agents

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Benchmark of 1,522 instances over 10 long user-agent histories with relation-controlled memory variants (complementary, nuanced, contradictory). It covers user-related and non-user-related queries and evaluates memory systems and Claw-style agents. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Findings.
